structure. Keep every name, model, position number, article number, date and condition exactly. Do not add or
remove any detail. Return only the reworded question.

The Ministerial Decree of 11 April 2011 says sixty days and Article 71 of Legislative Decree 81/2008 says forty-five: within how many days of the request must the first periodic verification be carried out today?

response.text: Given that the Ministerial Decree of 11 April 2011 states sixty days while Article 71 of Legislative Decree 81/2008 states forty-five, within how many days of the request does the first periodic verification have to be carried out at present?
